name: parsons-proof
description: Parsons problems for logical equivalence proofs as a dependency-free Web Component

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run build:lib
scripts.build:lib: vite build --mode lib && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && tsc -p types-test && tsc -p types-test/tsconfig.nodenext.json

stackblitz.startCommand: npm run test && npm run dev
